_why: The 67% human-typed rejection rate in docs/research/prompt-suggestion-filter-2026-08-05.md rests on a hand-labelled sample. No transcript field distinguishes a human pressing enter from an automation submitting a prompt (entrypoint is 'cli' for both, across 47,502 user records), so the split is a judgment call. It is recorded here so the call is auditable and the number reproducible, rather than asserted in prose.
_reproduce: python3 -c "import json,random; rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('corpus.jsonl')]; random.seed(7); print('\n'.join(r['text'][:100] for r in random.sample(rows,100)))"
rows at the indices below were labelled MACHINE; the rest HUMAN
machine_shapes: WARN SUPERVISOR PAGE / COMPLETION (program-terminal) / wait-contract  (desk alarms)
'You are the ORCHESTRATOR DESK' / 'Continue as the CONTROL-TOWER'  (handoff-brief pastes)
'Use the Bash tool to run exactly: echo ...'  (gate probes)
